sloka: अन्न निस्यंद जातानि मूलानि च फलानि च ।अमृत स्वादु कल्पानि ददृशुः तत्र वानराः ॥४-३७-२९॥
transliteration: anna nisyaṁda jātāni mūlāni ca phalāni ca ।amṛta svādu kalpāni dadṛśuḥ tatra vānarāḥ ॥4-37-29॥

translations.english: There the monkeys saw the Yajna, and partook the fruits and roots produced out of the havis which tasted sweet like nectar.
